reused_existing.role: style reference and reusable colourimeter plate

site_decisions: Added pale yellow AgI precipitation tube because chem-m8-l03.md names it and the existing m5x set has no AgI plate.
Strontium flame and sediment core were explicitly requested in brief 60 but not found in Chemistry Module 8 site HTML. They are optional until a lesson uses them.
The current site uses river water and treatment examples. The single capped bottle v2 is preferred over the dipper composite v1.

The organic test tubes follow chem-m8-l11.md and brief 60. The permanganate clear state represents the acidified colourless result; a brown precipitate can occur under other conditions described on the site.

The brief 57 qualitative-ion pre-design pack identified two further gaps in the precipitation set: cream AgBr and green Fe(OH)2. Both were added as imagegen edits of the AgI tube to match its rack and scale.
